overview: Eocyathispongia qiania is known from one phosphatized Doushantuo specimen. Its millimetre-scale body has three connected tubes interpreted as sponge-grade anatomy, a proposal based on a single fossil.
overviewZh: Eocyathispongia qiania 目前只有一件来自陡山沱组的磷酸盐化标本。毫米级身体由三根相连的管组成，研究者据此提出海绵级的解剖解释；这是单件化石支持的假说，不是已被多件材料重复验证的形态。

ecology.diet: The fossil does not directly preserve feeding.
ecology.habitat: Marine phosphorite records the depositional setting; the animal’s life position is not established.
ecology.locomotion: A sessile life habit is an interpretation, not a directly observed state.
ecology.guild: Suspension feeding is inferred from a possible sponge affinity, not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 化石未直接保存摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 海相磷块岩记录的是沉积环境；该动物生前所处的位置尚未确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 固着生活方式是一种解释，并非直接观察到的状态。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 保存下来的标本为毫米级。

traits: Three connected tubes
Openings compared with a funnel and an osculum
Tomography reveals internal cellular organization
evidenceSummary: Electron microscopy and tomography document the holotype shape. Sponge affinity remains uncertain because the specimen lacks spicules, a replicated canal system and corroborating fossils.
evidenceSummaryZh: 电子显微镜和断层成像记录了正模的形态。标本没有骨针、重复出现的水道系统或其他化石材料支持，因此其海绵亲缘仍不确定。

title.en: One fossil, a sponge-grade hypothesis
title.zh: 一件化石与海绵级假说

text.en: Eocyathispongia qiania is known from one phosphatized Doushantuo specimen. Its millimetre-scale body has three connected tubes interpreted as sponge-grade anatomy, a proposal based on a single fossil.
text.zh: Eocyathispongia qiania 目前只有一件来自陡山沱组的磷酸盐化标本。毫米级身体由三根相连的管组成，研究者据此提出海绵级的解剖解释；这是单件化石支持的假说，不是已被多件材料重复验证的形态。

title.en: Three connected tubes in one holotype
title.zh: 一个正模中的三根相连管道

text.en: The phosphatized holotype is millimetre-scale and preserves three connected tubes; openings were compared with a funnel and an osculum. SEM and tomography document its shape and internal cellular organization, but all of these observations come from one specimen.
text.zh: 磷酸盐化正模为毫米级，保存了三根相连的管道；作者将开口与漏斗和出水孔（osculum）作比较。扫描电镜（SEM）和断层成像记录了它的形状及内部细胞组织，但这些观察都来自同一件标本。

title.en: The sponge interpretation has clear limits
title.zh: 海绵解释的明确边界

text.en: The authors propose sponge-grade anatomy, but the specimen lacks spicules, a replicated canal system and corroborating fossils. Sessile life and suspension feeding are inferences from that proposed body plan, not directly observed states.
text.zh: 作者提出海绵级的解剖解释，但这件标本没有骨针、重复出现的水道系统，也没有其他化石印证。固着生活和悬浮摄食是根据所提出的体型方案作出的推断，并非直接观察到的状态。

title.en: Sponge grade body fossil with cellular resolution dating 60 Myr before the Cambrian
title.zh: Sponge grade body fossil with cellular resolution dating 60 Myr before the Cambrian

scope.en: Yin et al. (2015), pp. E1453?E1460, Figures 1?4 and Supplementary Movies: the single phosphatized holotype, tubes and openings, SEM/tomography and the bounded sponge-grade interpretation.

readerLimitations.en: The Weng’an Doushantuo occurrence is one fossil in marine phosphorite. Its depositional setting does not establish living position, and one specimen cannot define a global range or directly reveal feeding or locomotion.
readerLimitations.zh: Weng’an 陡山沱组的这一产出记录是一件形成于海相磷块岩中的化石。沉积环境不能确定它生前的位置；单件标本也无法界定全球分布范围，或直接揭示摄食与运动方式。

traitsZh: 具有被比作漏斗和出水口的开口。
断层成像显示其内部细胞组织结构。

commonNameZh: 螺旋格状埃迪卡拉纪海绵候选
overview: Helicolocellus cantori is known from goblet-shaped fossils with nested square grids. Researchers use that preserved framework to test an organic-skeleton body plan and a possible placement among crown sponges; the placement comes from a morphology matrix.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding inferred from the sponge interpretation
ecology.guild: Benthic suspension feeder inferred from morphology

traits: Goblet-shaped body
Nested square grids in the skeletal framework
Organic framework arranged in a helix
evidenceSummary: The holotype and referred specimens preserve the gridded framework. Its material composition, physiology and exact position near Hexactinellida remain interpretations.

title.en: Research overview
title.zh: 研究概述

text.en: Helicolocellus cantori is known from goblet-shaped fossils with nested square grids. Researchers use that preserved framework to test an organic-skeleton body plan and a possible placement among crown sponges; the placement comes from a morphology matrix.
text.zh: Helicolocellus cantori 已知于杯状化石，其骨架保存嵌套的方格网。研究者用这些保存结构检验有机骨架的身体构型，并以形态矩阵分析其是否接近海绵动物冠群。

title.en: A grid in a goblet-shaped fossil
title.zh: 杯状化石中的网格骨架

text.en:
The fossil has a goblet-shaped body. Its skeletal framework contains nested square grids.

The organic skeleton follows a helical arrangement.
text.zh:
杯状身体。

骨架结构中有嵌套的方格网。

有机骨架呈螺旋排列。

title.en: Inferences from the preserved framework
title.zh: 从保存的骨架结构作出的推断

text.en: The fossils are centimetre-scale and come from the marine Shibantan setting. Suspension feeding and sessile life are inferred from the sponge-body interpretation and morphology; they do not directly record physiology.
text.zh: 化石身体为厘米尺度，来自海相石板滩沉积环境。悬浮摄食和固着生活是根据海绵体构型解释与形态作出的推断，并非生理过程的直接记录。

title.en: What this evidence can establish
title.zh: 证据能说明什么

text.en: The holotype and referred specimens preserve the gridded framework. Its material composition, physiology and exact position near Hexactinellida remain interpretations.
text.zh: 正模和归入标本保存了网格骨架。其物质组成、生理功能以及在六放海绵纲附近的确切位置仍属于解释。

title.en: A late-Ediacaran crown-group sponge animal
title.zh: A late-Ediacaran crown-group sponge animal

scope.en: Describes Helicolocellus and a morphology-matrix placement near Hexactinellida; organic-skeleton homology remains an interpretation.
scope.zh: 描述 Helicolocellus 化石并以形态矩阵分析其接近六放海绵纲的位置；有机骨架同源解释仍未确定。

traitsZh: 骨骼框架中的嵌套方格网。

commonNameZh: 查恩伍德分叉水螅体化石
overview: BGS GSM 105875 preserves two branching, polyp-like tubes in a rigid organic skeleton, with impressions around their openings interpreted as tentacles. A morphology analysis tested whether Auroralumina belongs within crown Cnidaria; that placement remains an interpretation of one fossil.

ecology.diet: Tentacle impressions support a prey-capture interpretation, but no prey is preserved.
ecology.habitat: The Bradgate Formation and fossil surface are documented; a preferred habitat is not established here.
ecology.locomotion: The study interprets the organism as attached or sessile; this is inferred from the preserved form.
ecology.bodySize: The fossil is centimetre-scale and preserves a branching, colonial form.
ecology.guild: The study interprets it as a sessile feeder from its tentacle-bearing form; prey and feeding behaviour are not observed.
ecology.dietZh: 触手印痕支持其具有捕获猎物的解释，但没有保存下来的猎物。
ecology.locomotionZh: 研究将该生物解释为附着或固着生活；这是根据保存形态作出的推断。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这件化石为厘米级，保存了分枝的群体形态。

traits: Paired bifurcating polyps
Rigid organic skeleton
Tentacle impressions around apertures
evidenceSummary: The specimen and Bradgate Formation context are documented. Crown-cnidarian placement, tentacle function and feeding mode are interpretations of its anatomy.

title.en: A branching fossil with tentacle impressions
title.zh: 带有触手印痕的分叉化石

text.en: The specimen BGS GSM 105875 comes from the Bradgate Formation in Charnwood Forest, England. It preserves two bifurcating, polyp-like tubes inside a rigid organic skeleton, with tentacle impressions around the openings. These structures are observations in one centimetre-scale fossil; their role as feeding polyps is an interpretation, and the specimen does not preserve prey or colony physiology.
text.zh: 标本 BGS GSM 105875 出自英格兰查恩伍德森林的 Bradgate 组。它在刚性有机骨骼内保存了两个分叉的水螅体样管，开口周围可见触手印痕。这些结构来自一件厘米级化石；将其解释为摄食水螅体属于形态推断，标本没有保存猎物或群体生理信息。

title.en: What a branching body plan can suggest
title.zh: 分叉体形可以提示什么？

text.en: The study's morphology analysis places Auroralumina within crown Cnidaria, but this is a hypothesis based on anatomical characters, not proof that it was a direct ancestor of living cnidarians. The tentative sessile-feeder interpretation follows the tentacle-bearing form; prey, exact habitat preference and feeding behaviour remain unknown. The 562–557 Ma interval describes the Bradgate Formation context of this specimen, not the age of the cnidarian crown or a global range for the genus.
text.zh: 研究的形态分析将 Auroralumina 置于刺胞动物冠群内，但这是基于解剖性状的假说，并不能证明它是现生刺胞动物的直接祖先。固着摄食的暂定解释来自带触手的形态；猎物、确切栖息偏好和摄食行为仍未知。562–557 Ma 是这件标本的 Bradgate 组地层背景，不是刺胞动物冠群的年代或该属的全球分布。

title.en: Dunn et al. (2022), Charnwood Forest cnidarian fossil
title.zh: Dunn 等（2022），查恩伍德森林刺胞动物化石

scope.en: Specimen BGS GSM 105875, its Bradgate Formation setting, Figures 1–4 and Extended Data Figures 1–8. The study describes the branching tubes and tentacle impressions, then tests a crown-cnidarian placement in a morphology matrix; ecology and direct ancestry are not observations from the specimen.
scope.zh: 标本 BGS GSM 105875、Bradgate 组地层背景、图 1–4 及扩展数据图 1–8。研究描述了分叉管和触手印痕，并在形态矩阵中检验冠群刺胞动物位置；生态和直系祖先关系不是标本的直接观察。

commonNameZh: 埃迪卡拉纪肌肉印痕刺胞动物候选
overview: Holotype NFM F-994 and plastotype OUM ÁT.424/p preserve a quadrate Ediacaran impression with repeated aligned internal structures. These have been interpreted as muscle-like, but later studies dispute orientation and the strength of a staurozoan comparison.

ecology.diet: Feeding structures are not directly preserved, so diet remains unresolved.
ecology.habitat: The impression is from a marine Fermeuse Formation setting; its life position is uncertain.
ecology.locomotion: A sessile or attached life position has been proposed, but movement was not observed.
ecology.bodySize: The holotype impression is centimetre-scale; no full-body measurement is available.
ecology.guild: Both cnidarian affinity and feeding role remain contested.
ecology.dietZh: 化石没有直接保存取食结构，因此食性尚不明确。
ecology.habitatZh: 印痕来自海相 Fermeuse 组环境；生前所处位置不确定。
ecology.locomotionZh: 有研究提出它可能固着或附着生活，但没有观察到运动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 正模印痕为厘米尺度；没有可测的完整体长。
ecology.guildZh: 其刺胞动物亲缘关系及取食角色均有争议。

traits: The body impression is quadrate.
Repeated aligned structures appear inside the impression.
A muscle-like interpretation has been tested against comparisons with staurozoans.
evidenceSummary: The holotype and locality are documented. Tissue identity, orientation and precise cnidarian placement remain contested across the original description, critical reassessment and later re-examination.
overviewZh: 正模 NFM F-994 与塑模 OUM ÁT.424/p 保存了埃迪卡拉纪的方形印痕，内部有重复排列的结构。这些结构曾被解释为肌肉样组织，但后续研究对印痕方向及其与十字水母类比较的说服力提出异议。
traitsZh: 印痕内部可见重复排列的结构。
肌肉样组织的解释曾与十字水母类进行比较检验。
evidenceSummaryZh: 正模和产地有记录。原始描述、批判性重评和后续研究对组织身份、印痕方向及其具体刺胞动物位置仍有争议。

overview: Ou et al. describe 85 additional Chengjiang specimens plus type material and reconstruct Xianguangia as a tentaculate suspension feeder with stem-cnidarian affinity. Zhao et al. reinterpret the column-like feature as tentacle-sheath complexes and place Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; alternative coding yields an unresolved polytomy. The body's reconstruction and its evolutionary placement remain contested.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding is inferred from the reconstructed tentacle-bearing body; feeding was not directly observed.
ecology.habitat: The sampled fossils come from the marine Chengjiang deposit in Yunnan. This setting does not establish the species' full habitat or geographic range.
ecology.locomotion: An attached or sessile life habit has been proposed, but movement is not directly preserved.
ecology.bodySize: The reconstructed fossil body is centimetre-scale; these specimens do not establish a population-wide size range.
ecology.guild: A suspension-feeding role is proposed from reconstructed anatomy, not directly observed.
ecology.habitatZh: 取样化石来自云南的海相澄江生物群沉积层。这一地质环境不能确定该物种完整的栖息地或地理分布范围。
ecology.locomotionZh: 有人提出其具有附着或固着的生活方式，但运动并未被直接保存。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 重建的化石个体为厘米级；这些标本无法确定整个种群的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 根据重建的解剖结构，有研究提出其具有悬浮摄食功能；这并非直接观察所得。

traits: A tentacle-bearing oral crown appears in the published reconstruction.
A central column-like region is reinterpreted in later work as tentacle-sheath anatomy.
The expanded sample includes 85 new specimens and type material.
evidenceSummary: Ou et al. use the expanded sample to support a stem-cnidarian interpretation. Zhao et al. reinterpret the central structure and recover Xianguangia, Daihua, and Dinomischus as Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; sensitivity analyses produce an unresolved polytomy. Neither placement is definitive, and the Chengjiang sample is not a global first appearance.
overviewZh: Ou 等人描述了 85 件新增澄江标本及模式材料，并将 Xianguangia 重建为具触手的悬浮摄食者，认为其与刺胞动物干群有亲缘关系。Zhao 等人将柱状结构重新解释为触手鞘复合体，并在主要贝叶斯分析中把 Dinomischidae 置于栉水母干群；替代编码则得到未解析的多分叉。身体重建及其演化位置仍有争议。
evidenceSummaryZh: Ou 等人利用扩大的样本支持刺胞动物干群解释。Zhao 等人重新解释中央结构，并在主要贝叶斯分析中将 Xianguangia、Daihua 和 Dinomischus 恢复为栉水母干群上的 Dinomischidae；敏感性分析则得到未解析的多分叉。两种位置都非定论，澄江样本也不是全球首现记录。

readerSources.title: Three Cambrian fossils assembled into an extinct body plan of cnidarian affinity

scope.en: Ou et al. (2017), pp. 8835–8840, Figures 1–4 and supplementary figures: 85 additional specimens plus type material and the proposed tentaculate, stem-cnidarian reconstruction.
scope.zh: Ou 等（2017），第 8835–8840 页、图 1–4 与补充图：85 件新增标本及模式材料，以及具触手、刺胞动物干群解释的重建。

readerSources.title: Tentacular nature of the “column” of the Cambrian diploblastic Xianguangia sinica

scope.en: Zhao et al. (2023), Article 2215787, Figures 1–6, Figure 4 and Supplementary Figure S1: tentacle-sheath reinterpretation, the main Bayesian ctenophore-stem result and alternative-coding polytomy.
scope.zh: Zhao 等（2023），文章 2215787，图 1–6、图 4 与补充图 S1：触手鞘重新解释、主要贝叶斯栉水母干群结果，以及替代编码下的多分叉。

title.en: Eighty-five specimens and a reinterpreted central column
title.zh: 85 件标本与重新解释的中央柱状结构

text.en: Ou et al. describe 85 additional Chengjiang specimens plus type material and reconstruct Xianguangia as a tentaculate suspension feeder with stem-cnidarian affinity. Zhao et al. reinterpret the column-like feature as tentacle-sheath complexes and place Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; alternative coding yields an unresolved polytomy. The body's reconstruction and its evolutionary placement remain contested.
text.zh: Ou 等人描述了 85 件新增澄江标本及模式材料，并将 Xianguangia 重建为具触手的悬浮摄食者，认为其与刺胞动物干群有亲缘关系。Zhao 等人将柱状结构重新解释为触手鞘复合体，并在主要贝叶斯分析中把 Dinomischidae 置于栉水母干群；替代编码则得到未解析的多分叉。身体重建及其演化位置仍有争议。

title.en: Competing cnidarian-stem and ctenophore-stem placements
title.zh: 相竞争的刺胞动物干群与栉水母干群位置

text.en: Ou et al. use the expanded sample to support a stem-cnidarian interpretation. Zhao et al. reinterpret the central structure and recover Xianguangia, Daihua, and Dinomischus as Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem in their main Bayesian analysis; sensitivity analyses produce an unresolved polytomy. Neither placement is definitive, and the Chengjiang sample is not a global first appearance.
text.zh: Ou 等人利用扩大的样本支持刺胞动物干群解释。Zhao 等人重新解释中央结构，并在主要贝叶斯分析中将 Xianguangia、Daihua 和 Dinomischus 恢复为栉水母干群上的 Dinomischidae；敏感性分析则得到未解析的多分叉。两种位置都非定论，澄江样本也不是全球首现记录。

traitsZh: 已发表的重建图中呈现了带触手的口部冠状结构。
后续研究将中央柱状区域重新解释为触手鞘结构。
扩大的样本包括 85 件新标本和模式材料。

overview: The Raymond Quarry sample contains 182 compressed middle-Cambrian fossils of Burgessomedusa phasmiformis, with a large bell and many marginal tentacles. The authors support a medusozoan affinity, while its precise position changes with the analysis.
overviewZh: 雷蒙德采石场的中寒武世材料包括 182 件压扁保存的 Burgessomedusa phasmiformis 化石。化石显示较大的伞体和许多边缘触手；作者支持它属于刺胞动物亚门的水母类群（Medusozoa），但具体位置会随分析而变化。

ecology.diet: Predation is inferred by comparison with living medusozoans; no gut contents establish a meal.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the Raymond Quarry Burgess Shale setting. A position near the sea floor is inferred from preservation.
ecology.locomotion: Free swimming is inferred from the bell and comparison with medusozoans.
ecology.bodySize: The umbrella reaches about 20 cm in height.
ecology.guild: A swimming predator near the seafloor is a possible ecological interpretation; prey capture is unknown.
ecology.dietZh: 捕食性是通过与现生水母类比较推断的；没有胃肠内容物可以确认其摄食对象。
ecology.locomotionZh: 根据伞体结构并与刺胞动物亚门的水母类比较，推断其能够自由游泳。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 伞部高度约可达 20 厘米。
ecology.guildZh: 生活在近海底水域的游泳捕食者是一种可能的生态解释；其捕获猎物的情况未知。

traits: A cuboidal umbrella
More than 90 short tentacles around the margin
Radial internal features visible in compressed fossils
evidenceSummary: Figures 1–2 document the holotype and referred fossils. The analysis supports Medusozoa, but stem-cubozoan, stem-acraspedan and alternative placements depend on character coding.
evidenceSummaryZh: 图 1–2 展示了正模和归入化石。分析支持 Medusozoa 亲缘关系，但将它放在立方水母干群、Acraspeda 干群或其他位置，取决于性状如何编码。

title.en: A large bell, many tentacles, an uncertain branch
title.zh: 大型伞部、众多触手与尚不确定的分支位置

text.en: The Raymond Quarry sample contains 182 compressed middle-Cambrian fossils of Burgessomedusa phasmiformis, with a large bell and many marginal tentacles. The authors support a medusozoan affinity, while its precise position changes with the analysis.
text.zh: 雷蒙德采石场的中寒武世材料包括 182 件压扁保存的 Burgessomedusa phasmiformis 化石。化石显示较大的伞体和许多边缘触手；作者支持它属于刺胞动物亚门的水母类群（Medusozoa），但具体位置会随分析而变化。

title.en: Anatomy in the compressed fossils
title.zh: 压缩化石中的形态

text.en: The Raymond Quarry sample includes 182 compressed fossils. The umbrella is cuboidal and reaches about 20 cm in height, with more than 90 short marginal tentacles; radial internal features are visible in the compressed material.
text.zh: Raymond Quarry 样本包含 182 件压缩化石。伞部呈立方形，高度可达约 20 cm，边缘短触手超过 90 条；压缩材料中还能看到内部放射状结构。

title.en: Medusozoan affinity, model-sensitive placement
title.zh: 水母亚门亲缘较明确，具体位置依赖模型

text.en: The analysis supports a medusozoan affinity, while stem-cubozoan, stem-Acraspeda or alternative placements depend on character coding. The broad affinity is therefore clearer than the exact branch.
text.zh: 分析支持其与水母亚门（Medusozoa）有亲缘关系，但将它置于箱水母干群、水母类干群（Acraspeda）或其他分支，取决于特征编码。因此，宽泛的亲缘判断比精确分支位置更明确。

title.en: Swimming and feeding remain interpretations
title.zh: 游泳与摄食仍属解释

text.en: Bell shape and specimen associations support free swimming and a possible nektobenthic predatory habit. A near-seafloor position and prey capture are inferred; no gut contents document a meal.
text.zh: 伞部形状和标本间的关联支持其能够自由游动，并可能具有近底层捕食习性。近海底生活和捕食猎物都是推断；没有肠内容物记录到一次取食。

title.en: A macroscopic free-swimming medusa from the middle Cambrian Burgess Shale
title.zh: A macroscopic free-swimming medusa from the middle Cambrian Burgess Shale

scope.en: Moon et al. (2023), pp. 290:20222490, Figures 1?5 and Supplementary Figures S17?S21: Raymond Quarry anatomy, size, tentacles, medusozoan affinity, character-coding sensitivity and conditional ecological interpretation.

readerLimitations.en: The described fossils come from Raymond Quarry and define a locality-bounded sample, not a global range. Neither prey capture nor measured swimming performance is directly recorded.
readerLimitations.zh: 已描述的化石都来自 Raymond Quarry，构成受地点限定的样本，不能代表全球分布。捕食行为和游泳性能均未被直接记录或测量。

overview: Amphimedon queenslandica is a living demosponge sampled from the Great Barrier Reef for a draft genome. It offers comparisons among animal gene families; it is one living species, not a literal ancestral animal or a stand-in for every sponge.
overviewZh: Amphimedon queenslandica 是现生寻常海绵，研究样本来自大堡礁，用于建立草图基因组并比较动物基因家族。它代表一个现生物种，不是直接保存下来的祖先动物，也不能代替所有海绵类群。

evidenceSummary: The published assembly and comparisons report sequence content. Ancestral genomic toolkits are inferred by comparison; the work does not reconstruct a Precambrian individual, date a species origin or represent all Porifera.
evidenceSummaryZh: 论文报告了组装序列及其比较结果；对祖先基因工具箱的判断来自不同现生类群之间的比较。研究没有复原一只前寒武纪动物、确定物种起源时间，或代表整个 Porifera。

title.en: A living sponge genome, not a preserved ancestor
title.zh: 现生海绵的基因组，不是保存下来的祖先

text.en: Amphimedon queenslandica is a living demosponge sampled from the Great Barrier Reef for a draft genome. It offers comparisons among animal gene families; it is one living species, not a literal ancestral animal or a stand-in for every sponge.
text.zh: Amphimedon queenslandica 是现生寻常海绵，研究样本来自大堡礁，用于建立草图基因组并比较动物基因家族。它代表一个现生物种，不是直接保存下来的祖先动物，也不能代替所有海绵类群。

title.en: How the living sponge feeds
title.zh: 现生海绵如何摄食

text.en: Flagellated collar cells filter microbes and particulate organic matter from water, and the adult sponge is sessile. The study concerns living Amphimedon queenslandica sampled on the Great Barrier Reef; these observations describe that species, not an early-animal fossil.
text.zh: 领细胞以鞭毛驱动水流，从水中过滤微生物和颗粒有机物；成体海绵固着不动。研究对象是采自大堡礁的现生 Amphimedon queenslandica；这些观察描述的是该物种，不是早期动物化石。

title.en: Genome comparisons support bounded inferences
title.zh: 基因组比较支持有限范围的推断

text.en: The draft assembly is about 167 Mb, and the paper compares gene families involved in metazoan signalling and cell adhesion. Figures show the adult with a 5 cm scale bar, along with embryo and larval stages; ancestral genomic toolkits are comparative inferences, not a reconstructed Precambrian animal.
text.zh: 草图组装约为 167 Mb；论文比较了参与后生动物信号传导和细胞黏附的基因家族。图中成体带有 5 cm 比例尺，并展示胚胎和幼体阶段；祖先基因工具箱是通过比较得出的推断，不是复原出的前寒武纪动物。

title.en: The Amphimedon queenslandica genome and the evolution of animal complexity
title.zh: The Amphimedon queenslandica genome and the evolution of animal complexity

scope.en: Srivastava et al. (2010), pp. 466:720?726, Figures 1?5 and Supplementary Note 7: Great Barrier Reef sample, adult organization, 167 Mb draft genome and comparative gene-family analyses.

readerLimitations.en: This is one living demosponge sample from the Great Barrier Reef. It does not represent all Porifera, establish the species' origin date or supply a scalar fossil range.
readerLimitations.zh: 这是采自大堡礁的一个现生寻常海绵样本。它不能代表整个 Porifera，也不能确定该物种的起源年代，或为其提供单一数值的化石年代范围。

traitsZh: 一份约 167 Mb 的基因组草图。
参与后生动物信号传导和细胞黏附的基因家族。
图中包括成体、胚胎和幼体阶段。
